Gaza Humanitarian Response Update, 20 October 2026

Since 10 October, at least 1,250 people have been displaced from eastern Khan Younis to Al Mawasi.
According to the Ministry of Health, 42 people were killed and 118 injured between 13 and 19 October.
Partners reached 310,000 people with food parcels during the reporting period.
A total of 1,040 aid trucks entered the Gaza Strip through Kerem Shalom crossing.
The 2026 Flash Appeal requires US$4.1 billion, of which 38 per cent has been received.
